keySentence: He traded the gold for a horse.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Hans fell off the horse. He met a farmer. He traded for a cow. He traded the gold for a horse.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Hans rode the horse happily but then fell off. A farmer came by with a cow and offered to trade. He traded the gold for a horse and now the horse for a cow. Hans thought the cow was even better than a horse. He could get fresh milk from the cow every day. Hans always saw the bright side of everything.
facts.Word cards: gave = 줬다 / all = 전부 / away = 멀리 / kindness = 친절
